<function name="GetManipulateBoneAngles" parent="Entity" type="classfunc">
	<description>Gets the entity's angle manipulation of the given bone. This is relative to the default angle, so the angle is zero when unmodified.</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="boneID" type="number">The bone's ID</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="Angle">The entity's angle manipulation of the given bone.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
